arguments.command:
cd /home/runner/work/pi-action/pi-action; npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E "×|Tests|Errors"; git add -A src && git commit -q -m "feat: save the working tree with the thread and restore it at the start of a run

WorktreeContinuity (src/worktree.ts) saves a snapshot at each turn boundary
and when the thread closes, but only when the files changed. The
conversation points at its snapshot with the pi-action.worktree document
(history rewindable, fork asOf), written in the same commit as a marker
entry, so a fork sees the snapshot as of its fork entry.

Thread restores that snapshot before any interrupted work resumes, and
tells the model how it went in one message. When the newest snapshot has
work that exists nowhere else, it asks first (or, when nobody can answer,
keeps the newest files and says why). The worktree ref is pushed with the
thread ref in one atomic push.

Refs #33" && git push -q 2>&1 | tail -1; git log --oneline -1
